title: Rooftop Views! Luxury East Nash 3 BR Townehome
description:
Discover this charming townhouse in historic East Nashville, renowned for its lively music scene and quaint atmosphere. With easy access to coffee shops, restaurants, and bars, guests can explore the vibrant area. Accommodating families or groups of up to ten, the townhouse offers a cozy retreat in the heart of the action.
Permit #2024019832

The space
3 BR/ 2.5 BA sleeps up to 10 individuals
1st Floor- Entry, Laundry, 1 Bedroom with a 1 queen bed and 1 twin bed, Private full bathroom, garage converted to living space with TVs, couches, and ping pong table
2nd Floor- Half Bath, Kitchen, Living room, Dining room, 1 bedroom with queen bed
3rd Floor- Master Suite w/ Private Bathroom, Rooftop Balcony
Free Parking behind the building for 1 car + fcfs additional street parking

Guest access
Guest will have access to the entire townhouse, which includes 1 parking space located behind the building.
